note: Georgia DNR state park on Lake Walter F. George (Lake Eufaula) near Fort Gaines. Campground built in the 2025 revitalization; pool for overnight guests (seasonal), swimming beach, marina and boat ramp. --Claude
summary: Park page, 2025-12-11 press release and ReserveAmerica: confirmed 32-site campground with 50-amp full hookups, laundry, $40 weeknight / $44 Saturday (2026 and 2027), ReserveAmerica booking. Added max 50 ft (every listed site 30-50 ft), pull-throughs (all but site 26), the RA deep link. The press release says the park would welcome visitors to the new campground 'in early 2026' (the 'opened Dec 2025' in the note was the dedication); RA status 'Open year round'. Note trimmed of counts/hookups/booking/RV Life text. ParkPass $10 per vehicle once per stay ('Overnight guests pay daily ParkPass fee only once per vehicle during their stay') left to the inherited agency entrance row.
